name: Default
shortDescription: Self-hosted personal AI assistant gateway with a web Control UI for chat, model providers, tools and messaging channels.

alerts.message: Sign in to the Control UI by pasting the OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_TOKEN value from the environment as the Gateway secret. Each new browser must then be approved once: run openclaw devices list in the container terminal, then openclaw devices approve <requestId>.
An API key or sign-in for an LLM provider must be added under Settings > Models before the assistant can reply.
